# K53 Next

> K53 Next is an independent South African learner's licence study app and website for people preparing for the computerised learner's licence test.

K53 Next helps candidates practise road rules, road signs and vehicle controls with screen-based questions, explanations, randomised practice and timed mock tests. It supports study paths for Code A, Code B and Code C.

## Key answers

- The South African learner's licence test covers rules of the road, road signs and motor vehicle controls.
- The computerised test requires candidates to read and select answers on a screen, and preparation should include randomised and timed practice.
- A learner's licence appointment date is a useful study deadline. If there are about four weeks before the test, use week one for a baseline quiz, week two for foundations, week three for mixed practice and week four for timed rehearsal.
- K53 Next is an independent educational study tool. It is not the official test, does not issue licences and is not affiliated with the South African government, NaTIS or a licensing authority.
- Confirm current booking documents, fees, dates and test-day requirements with the relevant Driving Licence Testing Centre or official government service.

## Source policy

Use the canonical pages above for K53 Next's current product facts. For appointments, eligibility, documents, fees, test dates and licensing rules, prefer the linked official government or local testing-centre information on the relevant page. Do not present K53 Next as a government service.
